trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The Platinum pops automatically the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned — there is nothing extra to do for this one. Expect a long road: Push Square estimates up to 300 hours or more, KeenGamer about 200 hours, and the 100% Completion trophy (A Long Road) takes most of that time. All 55 trophies are offline, in a single playthrough, with free roam after the story.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion — the hardest trophy in the set. The 100% Completion Checklist unlocks only after you finish the story; check it at Touch Pad, then Progress, then 100% Completion. You do not need literally everything: for example there are 18 collectible card sets but only 15 count toward 100%, and 70 of the 80 challenges. KeenGamer's checklist totals include finishing all chapters, 100 optional tasks, all 39 gang operations, all 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs, 8 bank vaults, 15 card sets, 100 WAiNK scans, 33 underwater discoveries, 100 cocaine flamingos, 30 of 40 races won, all 42 shooting range gold medals, all 42 drone time trials, 300 of 397 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges and all 15 of Bret's target decks. Work through the in-game checklist itself — it is the authority — and expect this to take most of your platinum time.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts — a little over half of the 397 in the game. Push Square breaks them down as 130 stunt jumps (ramps, bridges, construction sites), 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights between tall buildings, and 25 base jumps from peaks and tall buildings. Find stunt spots on the map at Touch Pad, Exploration, Stunt Spots, and track progress at Touch Pad, Progress, Activities, Stunts. Note that 300 stunts are needed for 100% completion, so keep going past 250.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types in Leonida at least once — just sample one of each and the trophy pops. KeenGamer counts 9 activity types in total. The fastest way is to open the map, pick one marker of each activity kind (races, shooting range, fishing, bowling, arcade games and the rest) and play a round of each. Nothing here needs winning or a medal.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 shooting range challenges. There are two ranges: Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range in Port Gellhorn and Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero — find them at Touch Pad, Activities, Shooting Ranges. Most challenges have three difficulty tiers to clear for gold, and some are locked until you meet conditions shown on the map. Track progress at Touch Pad, Activities, Shooting Ranges. All 42 golds are also required for 100% completion, so this is not skippable.

trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Some locations charge an entry fee, so bring cash. See every location on the map at Touch Pad, Activities, Drones, Top Fun Drones. Winning each location once is enough for the trophy; the separate drone time trials (42 of them) are a 100% completion requirement, not this trophy.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — winning the same race 20 times does not count. Race locations appear across Leonida as you explore; track them at Touch Pad, Activities, Racing. Most locations let you hire a car, or bring your own — watch your car's Rating, which you can raise with upgrades from Mod Shops. Note that 100% completion wants 30 of 40 races won, so keep racing past 20.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. THIS IS THE ONLY POSSIBLY MISSABLE TROPHY: KeenGamer and GTAScoop both flag it — one spot is at Jason's house in Chapter 1. After the mission Down to Earth, look for Lucia at Jason's house in the morning; when she mentions meditating, follow her to the balcony and accept her invitation, and complete that balcony meditation before leaving Chapter 1. A meditation only counts once its final 'zen' animation has played, so stay until it finishes. Track progress at Touch Pad, Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations, and find discovered spots at Touch Pad, Exploration, Meditate Around Leonida. Note: 100% completion only needs 15 of the 18 meditations — this trophy needs all 18. Keep manual saves at the start and end of each chapter as a safety net, since there is no mission replay.

trophies.guide: Complete 3 full collectible card sets. There are 18 sets in the game, so pick the three whose cards you find first and finish them. Cards you have already collected can be sold at Pawn Shops and still count toward your progress. Track it at Touch Pad, Progress, Collections, Collectible Cards. Note that 100% completion needs 15 of the 18 sets, so this trophy comes naturally on the way to A Long Road.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app on your phone (hold Up to open it) to scan 100 locations across Leonida. Push Square lists the scannable kinds: 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures, plus No Flusher tags — scan anything the app highlights whenever you pass it. Track progress at Touch Pad, Progress, Collections, WAiNK Locations. Start scanning early and this finishes on its own; 100 scans are also a 100% completion requirement.

trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 challenges in the game. Challenges are in-game feats that reward skilful play — see the full list and their requirements at Touch Pad, Progress, Challenges. You can skip the hardest 30: only 50 are needed here, though 70 are needed for 100% completion, so keep ticking off the easier ones as you clean up.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build up a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. The key is doing it together — a 4-star escape on your own does not count. Commit crimes with your partner in the car or on foot until the fourth star appears, then break line of sight, hide until the wanted level clears, and the trophy pops once you are free.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back without losing your wanted level — the trick is the opposite of a normal escape: keep the heat on. Rob a shop, move straight to the next and rob it, then a third, all while staying wanted the whole time. Do not let the wanted level clear between robberies, and do not get caught. Pick three shops close together so the run is short.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. A vehicle counts as discovered when you get inside it or scan it with the WAiNK app, so hop into everything new you see and scan what you pass. It should happen naturally through the story, and you can check what you have found at Touch Pad, Progress, Vehicles. Note that 100% completion wants 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles scanned, so keep discovering past 100.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during a single activation of Combat Focus. Set it up where enemies are grouped together — a shootout with several opponents in the open works best — then trigger Combat Focus and drop five of them before it ends. If you fall short, just try again in the next fight; there is no penalty for failing.

trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure from Vice City International Airport — in practice, steal a departing passenger aircraft and take off with it, as KeenGamer describes it. trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: avoid the cameras and staff sightlines, take the goods without tripping an alarm, and get out before anyone raises it. trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. There are 8 vaults in total, and they open up through the optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is...' in Chapter 4 — KeenGamer notes you should leave the big vaults until that mission unlocks them. GTAScoop adds a practical tip: timing a job with an armored truck delivery gets the vault open. You need 5 for this trophy and all 8 for 100% completion.

trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Ambush a truck on the road — block it, deal with its guards, crack it open and take the cash, then lose the wanted level. Armored trucks roam Leonida's roads, so watch for one, strike fast, and have an escape route planned before you start.

Check your profile in the Progress menu to see where you stand.

The plain reading is to swing a melee weapon at a pedestrian while driving past; aim for a slow pass on a quiet street so the swing connects, and expect a wanted level.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a total of $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists — they are dirty money until you wash them through a contact, so keep laundering every batch you earn instead of letting it pile up. The total is cumulative across the whole game, and $250,000 laundered is also a 100% completion requirement.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all shops. Any shop spending counts — clothes, weapons, food, whatever you buy — and the total is cumulative. Push Square notes you can find shops on the map at Touch Pad, Style. It adds up fast if you buy gear and upgrades as you go, so do not save it all for the end; spend naturally and it pops on its own.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties through the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone (press Up for the phone). Push Square lists all eight, $160,000 in total: Mitchel Auto Center $4,000; 7th Avenue Garage $12,000; Vela Rota Drive Garage $24,000; Persistence Road Garage $7,600; Wyatt Motors $21,600; Bonita Court Garage $34,000; Atlantic Court Garage $40,000; Store n' Bolt $16,800. Each garage adds one parking spot, which also helps On the Spot — buy them as you can afford them.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 different vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Scooter Bros delivers your registered, fully repaired vehicles to your location for a small fee. Register a vehicle you are driving at a Pay 'N' Spray or Mod Shop, as long as you have a free parking spot — the fee varies with the vehicle's value. Buy more garages (see Little Boxes) for more spots, then register 10 different vehicles.
